report_label: NOT CLINICAL VALIDATION -- S1-OOD v1: hand-authored synthetic out-of-distribution notes; technical evaluation of extraction only.
purpose: Out-of-distribution evaluation of the T1->T2->T3 extractor: phrasing, aliases, scripts, quantity forms and orderings not produced by the S1 generator, plus cases that require abstention. Frozen; never used for tuning.

conventions.expected_grams: TOTAL grams per herb as written; never inferred from frequency, duration or vague wording.
conventions.expected_herbs: Only herbs whose prescription and quantity are unambiguous. Herbs that must not be emitted are listed in ood.abstain.
conventions.ood.spans: [text, type, occurrence, canonical]: token-aligned gold spans (T1 label set); herb spans carry the canonical herb (or the plant name for UNSTOCKED).
conventions.ood.abstain: [{herb, reason}]: emitting any of these is a confident error; not emitting it is a correct abstention.
conventions.dosha: Canonical set; an empty list means no dosha is stated.
